title: 115,200 minutes
learning_goal: Feel the precision of the wager as Verne wrote it.

quote.text: Eighty days or less; in nineteen hundred and twenty hours, or a hundred and fifteen thousand two hundred minutes.
quote.attribution: Jules Verne, Around the World in Eighty Days, ch. III (Towle translation, 1873)

review.notes:
